issues.title: Establish a reproducible hardening baseline and application-wide CI
acceptanceCriteria: Baseline commands and results are recorded
Failures are categorized

acceptanceCriteria: No service-role credential uses an EXPO_PUBLIC name

acceptanceCriteria: Full root test suite passes

issues.title: Remediate production dependency security advisories without breaking pinned runtime contracts
